mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_team_publish_receipts(tenant_id,request_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint,status) VALUES(#{tenant},CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{actor},#{fingerprint},'PROCESSING') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_team_publish_receipts SET status=#{status},response=CAST(#{response} AS jsonb),completed_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,request_fingerprint AS fingerprint,status,response::text AS response_json FROM nw_team_publish_receipts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
